scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.payload:migrate: cross-env NODE_ENV=development PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=payload.config.ts node --env-file=.env -r ./scripts/payload-next-env-shim.cjs -r tsx/cjs node_modules/payload/dist/bin/index.js migrate
scripts.payload:migrate:create: cross-env NODE_ENV=development PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=payload.config.ts node --env-file=.env -r ./scripts/payload-next-env-shim.cjs -r tsx/cjs node_modules/payload/dist/bin/index.js migrate:create
scripts.payload:migrate:run: cross-env NODE_ENV=development PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=payload.config.ts node --env-file=.env -r ./scripts/payload-next-env-shim.cjs -r tsx/cjs scripts/run-migrations.ts
scripts.seed:cases: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH=payload.config.ts node --env-file=.env -r ./scripts/payload-next-env-shim.cjs -r tsx/cjs scripts/seed-cases.ts
